title: Deploying AWS Lambda functions using AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK)
summary: AWS’s step-by-step tutorial for managing Lambda functions as Kubernetes custom resources: install the ACK Lambda controller in EKS, give it IAM permissions through IRSA, then `kubectl apply` a `Function` manifest that points at code in S3. It explains why you might (one GitOps and RBAC model for pods and functions) but, being AWS’s own post, not the drawbacks.
